title: His wife Maddie's singing career in shows and theaters
summary: Maddie Spencer sang with Joe Oliver, Freddie Keppard at the Rosebud theater and road shows like Florida Blossoms, until about 1932.

story.theme_name: Singers and the musicians who accompanied them

blocks.x: Her name is Maddie, was, at that time, was Maddie Spencer. And they, she went in the name of Sweet. And now she's going in the name of Maddie Murray.
And who all did she sing with?

Oh, Lord, I couldn't tell you who all she had in singing. Well, I mean here. In the city here. Joe Oliver, she sing with Joe Oliver at the, where did this man here at the nightclub down on Basin Street. I can't hear, he had a nightclub on Basin Street. And he moved his night, they moved his nightclub down to Claiborne Street. P. Lala. Then she sang with Freddie Kepler up at the Rosebud, or Rosebud's Theater. That was about the first colored theater here, with entertainment. The colored entertainers working down there, was at the Rosebud. That was the whole drive between Jackson and Phillip. And that was before the lyrics started.
So she's had some good experience.

Oh, she had plenty of the Elfwaters and all of them. She had worked with all of them. She was singing and they was, what they, this is the chorus girls. Well, yeah, she's had plenty of experience about it. Really experienced about it. She followed up that until 19 and 30, she quit. Well, not, yeah, follow up the show, clean up to around 1932. That's right.
